mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it showed how nerves and blood routes connect the regions and support muscles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the urinary organs was clear but felt mostly like placing a named part in its slot, with little to figure out.

surprise.text: The diaphragm separating the chest from the abdomen helped me picture how the regions fit together while routes still pass between them.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. Some placements followed named slots or offered pairings rather than requiring me to work out compatibility.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the connected systems work together. This assembly was satisfying, though several fittings were predictable.
